text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #23313d

g.text: Percentile design treats reach, clearance, and adjustability as different requirements

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Assigned normal dimension gives5th≈51.78 cm and95th≈68.22 cm. These are not anthropometric measurements of an actual population. A reach limit typically
considers smaller users; clearance considers larger dimensions. Percentile coverage is dimension-specific and cannot be combined into a universal “5th-
percentile person.” Clothing, posture, task, and population change requirements.
